items.description: RouterPlex is a hosted prepaid LLM gateway: one API key for 86 AI models, OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible, claiming up to 40% cost savings via a built-in optimizer and always-on reliability.
API base URL is https://api.routerplex.com/v1; supports OpenAI chat completions, Anthropic /v1/messages, and the Responses API (used by Codex CLI).

Pay as you go: top up from $5, pay per token at vendor list prices, $0 top-up fee, no RPM/TPM caps, credit never expires, balance cannot go negative (stops at zero). Crypto top-ups via NOWPayments with a $15 minimum.
Subscription plans: Plex Lite $10/month gives $11 credits; Plex Pro $30/month gives $35 credits; Plex Max $100/month gives $125 credits.
Pricing page (pay-as-you-go and Plex Lite/Pro/Max plans)
Machine-readable pricing in Markdown (plan limits, credits, billing terms)
Quickstart: create a key and send the first request
Integration setup guides for editors and coding agents (Claude Code via ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, Cursor, Codex CLI, OpenCode, Cline, Aider, Zed, etc.), plus the RouterPlex CLI (npx routerplex)
API reference docs: authentication, chat completions, Anthropic Messages, streaming, image generation, decision models, models, errors & limits, keys & budgets, usage API, billing
All model API pricing: live per-token prices and workload calculator for every model
Per-model and per-vendor pricing pages (price per 1M input/output tokens, context window)

Comparison pages of RouterPlex vs other gateways and hosts (OpenRouter, LLM Gateway, Vercel AI Gateway, Requesty, Fireworks, Together, Groq, LiteLLM, Portkey, Helicone), with sourced gateway fees data (JSON/CSV)
Blog guides on model API pricing/setup, coding agent configuration, and gateway pricing comparisons
